law.title: Following fire apparatus prohibited
law.text: The driver of any motor vehicle other than an authorized emergency vehicle on official business shall not follow any fire apparatus traveling in response to a fire alarm closer than 500 feet or driving to or park such vehicle within 500 feet of fire apparatus which stopped in answer to a fire alarm.

activation_conditions: fire apparatus is travelling in response to a fire alarm, or has stopped in answer to one
the subject follows it within 500 feet, or drives to or parks within 500 feet of it
exceptions: an authorized emergency vehicle on official business
residue: 'in response to a fire alarm' and 'in answer to a fire alarm' are purposes; the observable evidence is the apparatus's warning lamps and siren
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the 500-foot separation is required for the whole time the subject follows or stands near the apparatus
